title: Chemical elements: what they are named after

source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?namedLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (SAMPLE(?p) AS ?named) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q11344 ; wdt:P138 ?p . } GROUP BY ?item HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?p)=1) } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . named_after.pick: What is the element {label} named after?
named_after.match: Match each element to what its name comes from.

rows.label: aluminium
rows.description: metallic chemical element of silvery appearance with symbol Al and atomic number 13
rows.hook: is a light, silvery metal used to make soda cans and kitchen foil

rows.label: hydrogen
rows.description: chemical element with symbol H and atomic number 1
rows.hook: is the lightest and most abundant element in the universe, and fuels the stars

rows.label: copper
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Cu and atomic number 29
rows.hook: is a reddish-orange metal used in electrical wiring and pennies

rows.label: tungsten
rows.description: chemical element with symbol W and atomic number 74
rows.hook: is the metal with the highest melting point, used in old light bulb filaments

rows.label: plutonium
rows.description: radioactive chemical element with symbol Pu and atomic number 94
rows.hook: is a radioactive element used as fuel in nuclear weapons and reactors

rows.label: oxygen
rows.description: chemical element with symbol O and atomic number 8
rows.hook: is the gas humans breathe in to stay alive, making up about a fifth of the air

rows.label: carbon
rows.description: chemical element with symbol C and atomic number 6; common element of all known life
rows.hook: is the basis of all known life, found in diamonds and pencil lead

rows.label: uranium
rows.description: radioactive, metallic chemical element with symbol U and atomic number 92
rows.hook: is a heavy radioactive metal used to fuel nuclear power plants

rows.label: oganesson
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Og and atomic number 118
rows.hook: is the heaviest element on the periodic table, made only in labs and lasting a fraction of a second

rows.label: potassium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol K and atomic number 19
rows.hook: is a soft metal found in bananas that reacts violently when dropped into a sink

rows.label: lithium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Li and atomic number 3
rows.hook: is the lightest metal, used in rechargeable batteries for phones and electric cars

rows.label: silicon
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Si and atomic number 14
rows.hook: is the main ingredient in sand and glass, and the heart of computer chips

rows.label: helium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol He and atomic number 2; rare gas; noble gas
rows.hook: is the light gas that fills party balloons and makes your voice squeaky

rows.label: krypton
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Kr and atomic number 36; rare gas
rows.hook: is a noble gas that shares its name with the home planet of a famous comic-book superhero

rows.label: cobalt
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Co and atomic number 27
rows.hook: is a metal that gives glass and pottery a deep blue color

rows.label: titanium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ti and atomic number 22
rows.hook: is a strong, light metal used in jet engines, bike frames and hip replacements

rows.label: chlorine
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Cl and atomic number 17
rows.hook: is a poisonous yellowish gas used to disinfect swimming pools

rows.label: xenon
rows.description: chemical element with atomic number of 54 and heaviest stable noble gas
rows.hook: is a heavy noble gas used in car headlights and camera flash lamps

rows.label: boron
rows.description: chemical element with symbol B and atomic number 5
rows.hook: is a hard element used in laundry additives and heat-resistant lab glassware

rows.label: iodine
rows.description: chemical element with symbol I and atomic number 53
rows.hook: is a dark solid that turns to purple vapor, added to table salt to prevent thyroid problems

rows.label: astatine
rows.description: chemical element with symbol At and atomic number 85
rows.hook: is the rarest naturally occurring element on Earth, and intensely radioactive

rows.label: selenium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Se and atomic number 34
rows.hook: is a trace mineral that is essential in tiny amounts and is used in dandruff shampoo

rows.label: manganese
rows.description: chemical element, symbol Mn and atomic number 25
rows.hook: is a metal added to steel to make it tougher, and is essential in small amounts for the body

rows.label: osmium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Os and atomic number 76
rows.hook: is the densest naturally occurring element, used in pen tips

rows.label: palladium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Pd and atomic number 46
rows.hook: is a silvery metal used in catalytic converters that clean up car exhaust

rows.label: beryllium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Be and atomic number 4
rows.hook: is a light, stiff metal used in space telescope mirrors and X-ray windows

rows.label: iridium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ir and atomic number 77
rows.hook: is an extremely dense metal, rich in the layer of rock linked to the dinosaurs' extinction

rows.label: polonium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Po and atomic number 84
rows.hook: is a radioactive element discovered by Marie and Pierre Curie

rows.label: bromine
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Br and atomic number 35
rows.hook: is one of only two elements that are liquid at room temperature, a reddish-brown fuming one

rows.label: fluorine
rows.description: chemical element with symbol F and atomic number 9
rows.hook: is the most reactive element, added to toothpaste to fight cavities

rows.label: neon
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ne and atomic number 10; rare gas that glows reddish-orange in a vacuum discharge tube
rows.hook: is the noble gas that lights up glowing signs in shop windows

rows.label: argon
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ar and atomic number 18; rare gas
rows.hook: is the third most common gas in the air, often used to fill light bulbs

rows.label: calcium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ca and atomic number 20
rows.hook: is the mineral that builds strong bones and teeth, found in milk

rows.label: gallium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ga and atomic number 31
rows.hook: is a soft metal that melts in your hand, a favorite science-class party trick

rows.label: vanadium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol V and atomic number 23
rows.hook: is a metal used to strengthen steel for tools, and named for a goddess of beauty and love

rows.label: caesium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Cs and atomic number 55
rows.hook: is a soft metal that explodes on contact with liquid, used in the most precise atomic clocks

rows.label: cadmium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Cd and atomic number of 48
rows.hook: is a toxic metal once used in rechargeable batteries and bright yellow paint pigments

rows.label: thorium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Th and atomic number 90
rows.hook: is a mildly radioactive metal named for a god of thunder, studied as a possible nuclear fuel

rows.label: tantalum
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ta and atomic number 73
rows.hook: is a corrosion-resistant metal used in the capacitors inside phones and laptops

rows.label: germanium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ge and atomic number 32
rows.hook: is the metalloid used in the first transistors and in fiber-optic cables

rows.label: moscovium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Mc and atomic number 115
rows.hook: is a superheavy element made in a lab, with an existence of mere fractions of a second

rows.label: rhodium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Rh and atomic number 45
rows.hook: is one of the priciest precious metals, used to plate jewelry and clean up car exhaust

rows.label: francium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Fr and atomic number 87
rows.hook: is one of the rarest and most unstable elements, with a half-life of only about 20 minutes

rows.label: tennessine
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Ts and atomic number 117
rows.hook: is a superheavy element created in a lab, and one of the newest additions to the periodic table

rows.label: californium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Cf and atomic number 98
rows.hook: is a radioactive element used in portable neutron sources to find oil and start reactors

rows.label: yttrium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Y and atomic number 39
rows.hook: is a metal used to make red phosphors in old color TV screens and in LEDs

rows.label: zirconium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Zr and atomic number 40
rows.hook: is a metal that resists corrosion and is used in nuclear reactors and imitation diamonds

rows.label: niobium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Nb and atomic number 41
rows.hook: is a metal used in superconducting magnets and for the alloys in MRI machines

rows.label: tellurium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Te and atomic number 52
rows.hook: is a brittle silvery element used in solar panels, with a garlic-like smell when absorbed by the body

rows.label: strontium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Sr and atomic number 38
rows.hook: is the metal that gives fireworks their brilliant crimson glow

rows.label: americium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Am and atomic number 95
rows.hook: is a radioactive element found inside household smoke detectors

rows.label: scandium
rows.description: chemical element with symbol Sc and atomic number 21
rows.hook: is a light metal added to aluminum alloys for stadium seats and baseball bats
